suites.name: Tier 1 - Feature 1: Multi-Page Architecture & HTTP Status

tests.name: 1.1 index.html returns HTTP 200 and loads valid HTML5 doctype
1.2 services.html returns HTTP 200 with viewport meta tag
1.3 portfolio.html returns HTTP 200 with viewport meta tag
1.4 contact.html returns HTTP 200 with viewport meta tag
1.5 Core CSS stylesheets link correctly and produce no 404 network errors

2.2 No external CSS framework stylesheets linked
2.3 Global window scope is pure vanilla with zero library pollution
